embeds.title: Commands
embeds.description:
Some Of Our Premier Commands
* `/help`  -This command or use /helpublic
* `/configcustom` -Setups up a configuration for specific ai model (needs api key)
* `/configdefault`- Makes server go back to default configuration
* `/giveacc`- Gives acces in server to let sm1 Talk to ai
* `/removeacc` -Removes Acesss
* `/Toggle` -Toggles ai on and off
* `/add` - Gives link to add to server invite for bot

fields.name: # **Ai Chat Explained**:
fields.value:
With Our bot ,You can gain the power of **Super Intelligence**
**By default Admins can use ai chat features**
* `/toggle`- Toggles Ai Chat
* `/configcustom` - lets you configure custom models(on hugginface api)
* `/configdefault` - Lets you configure the default model
* `/giveacc` - Gives Access to someone else
* `/removeacc` - Removes Access
